blocks.content: Course: React Hooks: Level Up Your First Web App
Congrats on completing our React Hooks course and enhancing your journal app 🥳 🎉
Here's what you've learned from the course:

items: What side effects are and how useEffect() runs and cleans up after itself.
How the dependency array controls when an effect re-runs.
Fetching data from an API and reflecting the result in the UI.
Handling loading, error, and empty states as distinct UI conditions.
Accessing DOM elements with useRef() to autofocus inputs.
Closing a drawer on outside click or Escape using a ref and event listeners.
Deriving values with useMemo() to avoid redundant recalculations.
Stabilising function references with useCallback() to prevent unnecessary re-renders.
What custom hooks are, when to extract one, and how useFetch(), useSearch(), and usePagination() each encapsulate one concern.

blocks.content: And you learned all that while enhancing your Journal app. Like I said in the previous courses, that's an achievement worth sharing!
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
